title: KMZ Double Car Air Mattress with 2 Pillows — for Boot and Rear Seat
short_description: Inflatable car bed in double size (195 x 126 x 14 cm) for the boot and rear seat, with two inflatable pillows and an air pump.
long_description: The KMZ car air mattress (model KMZL001-2) is an inflatable car bed for the boot and rear seat and measures 195 x 126 x 14 cm. The surface is double-sided flocked PVC and is waterproof. The set includes an air pump, two inflatable pillows, a repair patch and a carry bag. At around 4 kg it is easy to take along in the car.
